$comment: Endpoint names consumed from T4's staged services patch (services/pending/services-endpoints.patch). T3 names the constants only; T4 owns the services behind them. Never invent *.imput.net or *.zenmium.internal hosts — these are the canonical names.

consumers.ZENMIUM_SERVICES_BASE_URL: Control-plane lookups for internal products (pairing bootstrap metadata, product registry). zenmiumctl pair --product <slug> resolves product descriptors here when T4 is live.
consumers.ZENMIUM_UPDATES_BASE_URL: Update channel metadata (T4 owns; named here so internal/ does not hardcode an imputnet or placeholder host).
consumers.ZENMIUM_CRASH_BASE_URL: Crash reporter endpoint (T4 owns; named for completeness).
